_note: What you see: Speed and curve of all transitions, with play button
_note_nl: Wat je ziet: Snelheid en curve van alle overgangen, met afspeelknop
Geen component gekozen: de basistokens v: No component chosen: Nextcloud's base tokens, which apply everywhere.
Duur 300 ms, easing cubic-bezier(0.2, 0,: Duration 300 ms, easing cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1). Replays the dialog and the notification.
Dit zijn basistokens van Nextcloud. Ze s: These are Nextcloud base tokens. They are open because "Also edit Nextcloud's base tokens" is on; a change affects every page.
x1 van de curve van Beweging: x1 of the curve of Motion
y1 van de curve van Beweging: y1 of the curve of Motion
x2 van de curve van Beweging: x2 of the curve of Motion
y2 van de curve van Beweging: y2 of the curve of Motion
Een duur is een getal met ms of s, tot 5: A duration is a number with ms or s, up to 5 seconds. An easing is one of the five words or a custom curve with both x values between 0 and 1. Anything outside those rules the server does not save, and you see why.
1 override, alleen in de voorvertoning t: 1 override, only in the preview until you save.
Elke overgang van Nextcloud en de Conduc: Every transition of Nextcloud and the Conduction apps reads these three tokens: menus, dialogs, the sidebar, notifications and tabs.
Motion-tokens hebben een vast type: de s: Motion tokens have a fixed type: the server checks every value before it saves anything.
